```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
```

Interactive data visualizations Brian has contributed to.

```{r}
portfolio <- read_csv("data/portfolio.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

## Blank lines between/within these HTML fragments make pandoc split them
## into separate paragraphs (it inserts a stray empty <p> for each blank
## line, since <a>/<span> are inline tags, not recognized HTML block tags
## eligible for raw passthrough) - keep every line single-newline-joined,
## with no blank line anywhere in the sequence, so it's emitted as one
## unbroken raw HTML block.
portfolio %>%
  mutate(
    image_path = file.path("images/portfolio", image),
    has_image = file.exists(image_path),
    thumb_html = ifelse(
      has_image,
      glue("<img src='{image_path}' class='portfolio-thumb' alt='{title}'>"),
      "<span class='portfolio-thumb portfolio-thumb-placeholder'></span>"
    )
  ) %>%
  glue_data(
    "<a class='portfolio-card' href='{url}' target='_blank' rel='noopener'>",
    "{thumb_html}",
    "<span class='portfolio-card-body'>",
    "<strong>{title}</strong><br>",
    "<span class='meta'>{description}</span>",
    "</span>",
    "</a>",
    .sep = ""
  ) %>%
  paste(collapse = "\n") %>%
  {glue("<div class='portfolio-grid'>\n{.}\n</div>")} %>%
  cat()
```
